name: Santa Cecilia (Spain)
description: White field with a red stripe near the top and a green stripe near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Cecilia (a harp, a castle, a tree and an anchor).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cecilia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Cecilia arms — harp, castle, tree and anchor
